description: AT Protocol projection of an AgentAuthorityToken (AAT) mint event on Base L2 (per ADR-2605231500). One record per AAT, indexed by the on-chain tokenId. The AAT is a soulbound ERC-721 + ERC-5192 token analogous to AdherentRegistry but for AI agents: a human Steward (who holds an Adherent SBT) delegates a scoped, revocable authority to one agent DID. Constitutional: AAT MUST NOT confer voting power (only Adherent SBT = 1 human = 1 vote per ADR-2605192100 §1.16). AAT is the authority chain that lets AI agents drive UNSPSC commodity flows end-to-end without being mistaken for human members.

tokenId.description: Base L2 AgentAuthorityToken ERC-721 token ID (monotonic, starting at 1 per OpenZeppelin convention).

agentDid.description: DID of the AI agent receiving the AAT. Typically `did:web:c{unspsc-code}.etzhayyim.com` for UNSPSC commodity agents (per 2026-05-23 commit 9cd4fe73d).

stewardDid.description: DID of the human Steward delegating authority. MUST hold an Adherent SBT (verified on-chain via AdherentRegistry.locked(stewardAdherentTokenId)). Revocable by the Steward or by Council multisig.

stewardAdherentTokenId.description: Adherent SBT token ID that grounds the delegation. Allows verifiers to trace agent action → human Steward → constitutional accountability.

mintTxHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the AgentAuthorityToken.mint() call. Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

scope.description: What the agent is allowed to do — UNSPSC prefixes, esign purposes, per-envelope value cap.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the AAT auto-revokes. MUST be present (no perpetual authority).

revokedAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp when the AAT was manually revoked (by Steward or Council). Absence means the AAT is currently valid.

revocationReason.description: Free-form Markdown reason for revocation. Present iff revokedAt is set.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of AAT mint observation.

unspscPrefixes.description: UNSPSC code prefixes the agent may handle (e.g., `4322` for laboratory + medical supplies). Empty array means no scope; `00` means all codes (Council-only authority).

purposes.description: Which `com.etzhayyim.esign.envelope.purpose` enum values the AAT permits. MUST exclude `purchase`/`sale`/`subscription`/`lease`/`tip` — those are not valid Charter-aligned purposes.

valueCap.description: Per-envelope value ceiling. Phase 1 interpretation: maximum item count per envelope. Phase 2 interpretation: maximum USDC-equivalent (6 decimals) per envelope. valueCap=0 means no value gate at this AAT (rely on Council escalation threshold in the per-UNSPSC processManifest).
